units.source_text: 时值5月，柏木制定了一个游岚山的计划，他怕假日人多，选定了平日旷课前往。

en.t: It was May, and Kashiwagi made a plan to visit Arashiyama. Afraid there would be too many people on a holiday, he chose a weekday and decided to skip class to go.

units.source_text: 不愧是柏木，他说要是晴天就不去，阴天就去。

en.t: True to Kashiwagi, he said that if it was sunny he would not go, but if it was cloudy he would.

units.source_text: 他计划自己陪伴那位住在西班牙式洋房的小姐，而给我带来一位他的房东的女儿。

en.t: His plan was to accompany the young lady who lived in the Spanish-style Western house himself, and to bring along his landlord's daughter for me.
